locale.description: BCP 47 language tag for this glossary slice

version.description: Optional glossary version, recorded in manifests. The result cache keys on the content of the entries each string uses, so bumping this alone re-runs nothing.

productMeaning.description: What the product means by this term

relatedTerms.description: Related industry terms (e.g. the names other tools use)

practitionerTerm.description: Preferred practitioner-facing term in the locale

approved.description: Whether the practitionerTerm is approved for use

origin.description: Where the entry came from. `council glossary apply` sets { via: "harvest", keys } on entries a person approved from harvested proposals, and { via: "reference", from, keys } on terms carried over from another app's glossary.

from.description: The app whose glossary the term came from (via: reference)

keys.description: Catalog keys whose shipped strings were the evidence

declined.description: English terms a person decided are not glossary terms. `council glossary harvest` never proposes them again. Never sent to providers.
